articles.title: Apple should have made the MacBook logo RGB
articles.description: When Apple CEO John Ternus announced the first touchscreen Mac last month, the biggest reaction in the room wasn't for the PROLED MacBook Pro's OLED touchscreen or the thinner and lighter chassis; it was for the illuminated lid logo. It's a throwback to the light-up logos on the old MacBooks, which Apple started phasing out […]

articles.title: Donald Trump really wants Tim Cook to run Nvidia
articles.description: Jensen Huang resigned this morning as Nvidia's CEO following reports of affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy.
